payload.description: A 7-step guide to using Wispr Flow voice dictation with Claude Cowork to get richer outputs in less time. Learn why typing slows your AI sessions and how talking your prompts — messy, unfiltered, and long — delivers far better context than carefully crafted typed text. Based on a practical workflow by Claude power user Ruben Hassid.
payload.name: Speed Up Claude Cowork 4x with Voice Dictation
payload.title: Speed Up Claude Cowork 4x with Voice Dictation
